**Professional Experience**

Led the architecture of a Next.js-based patient portal, integrating real-time data from REST APIs to reduce load times by 40% through lazy loading and code splitting. Collaborated with product stakeholders to align UI/UX with clinical workflows, resulting in a 25% increase in user engagement. Implemented Web Accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1) across core components, ensuring compliance with India’s Digital Accessibility Rules. Mentored 3 junior engineers on state management patterns using Redux and Zustand, reducing bug resolution time by 30%.  

**Mid-Level Frontend Engineer** | HealthLoop Technologies (2019–2021)  
Architected a reusable React component library for internal tools, cutting development time for repetitive UI elements by 50%. Designed a test automation framework using Jest and Cypress, improving regression test coverage from 60% to 85% across critical features. Spearheaded the adoption of TypeScript in legacy codebases, eliminating 15+ runtime errors and improving maintainability.  

**Junior Frontend Engineer** | HealthLoop Technologies (2018–2019)  
Contributed to the redesign of a dashboard for healthcare providers, optimizing responsive design for 10+ screen sizes and improving mobile usability metrics by 35%. Developed a custom state management solution for a high-traffic feature, reducing server-side rendering overhead by 20%.  

**Frontend Developer Intern** | HealthLoop Technologies (2017–2018)  
Supported the development of a telemedicine app, focusing on performance optimization techniques like image compression and caching strategies. Collaborated with backend teams to refine REST API endpoints, reducing average response times by 25%.
